product_name: Lava Agni 4 5G (8GB RAM, 256GB Storage, Lunar Mist) | Metal Body | MTK Dimensity 8350 Processor (1.4Mn+ Antutu) | 1.5K AMOLED Display | 50MP OIS Camera | LPDDR5X RAM | UFS 4.0 | 4K@ 60fps | Vayu AI
description: Blazing Performance — Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8350 (4 nm) octa-core chipset clocked at 3.35 GHz, the Agni 4 delivers over 1.4 million on AnTuTu v10 for lightning-fast multitasking and gaming. Stunning Shots — The 50MP OIS main camera and 8MP ultra-wide capture sharp, stable photos across all lighting conditions, while the 50MP selfie camera with 4K 60fps video brings pro-level clarity to your portraits and videos. Vayu AI Intelligence — Built-in generative AI with multiple agents (like math teacher, English tutor, image editor) + deep voice and system-level controls make everyday tasks smarter and more intuitive. Premium Metal Frame Design — Crafted in aluminium-alloy frame with Gorilla Glass protection, and IP64 splash/dust resistance making Agni 4 sturdy but sleek. Custom Action Key — A dedicated button that supports 100+ shortcuts for camera, torch, apps, or modes via single/double/long presses—totally customizable to your workflow.
